title: a car / some money (countable/uncountable 2)
summary: **a/an** и **some**; слова, которые бывают и исчисляемыми, и неисчисляемыми; слова, которые в английском неисчисляемые (**information, advice, news, bread, hair, furniture, work**).
ru:
## a / an и some
Выбор зависит от типа существительного:
- **a / an** + исчисляемое в единственном числе: *I need **a** new car. Would you like **an** apple?*
- **some** + исчисляемое во множественном числе: *I need **some** new shoes. Would you like **some** apples?*
- **some** + неисчисляемое: *I need **some** money. Would you like **some** cheese?*
> Linda bought **a** hat, **some** shoes and **some** perfume. — Линда купила шляпу, туфли и духи.

## some — «немного, несколько»
**some** означает «какое-то количество», когда мы не уточняем сколько. Часто в утверждениях и в предложениях-предложениях (*Would you like some tea?*).

## Одно слово — два значения
Некоторые слова бывают и исчисляемыми, и неисчисляемыми — смысл разный.
> I want something to read. I'm going to buy **a paper** (= a newspaper). — газета
> I need to make a list. I need **some paper** / **a piece of paper**. — бумага
> There's **a hair** in my soup. — волосок / She has long **hair**. — волосы

## Слова-ловушки: неисчисляемые в английском
Эти слова по-русски можно посчитать, а по-английски — **нет**: **information, advice, news, weather, bread, hair, furniture, work**. Нет **a** и нет **-s**.
> I need **some information** about hotels. (не ~~an information~~, ~~informations~~)
> It's **nice weather** today. (не ~~a nice weather~~)
> I've just had **some good news**. (не ~~a good news~~)
> I'm going to buy **some bread**. (не ~~a bread~~)
> Sue has got very long **hair**. (не ~~hairs~~)
> They've got **some nice furniture**. (не ~~furnitures~~)
> It's **hard work**. (не ~~a hard work~~)

## Как посчитать
- **a piece of** information / advice / news / furniture / bread
- **a loaf of** bread, **a slice of** bread

## Глагол
С неисчисляемыми глагол в единственном числе: *The news **is** good. The weather **is** nice.*

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~I need an advice.~~ → I need **some advice**. / **a piece of advice**.
- ~~It's a nice weather.~~ → It's **nice weather**.
- ~~The news are bad.~~ → The news **is** bad.
- ~~I like my work, but it's a hard work.~~ → but it's **hard work**.
en:
## a / an and some
- **a / an** + singular countable noun: *I need **a** new car. Would you like **an** apple?*
- **some** + plural countable noun: *I need **some** new shoes.*
- **some** + uncountable noun: *I need **some** money. Would you like **some** cheese?*
> Linda bought **a** hat, **some** shoes and **some** perfume.

## Both countable and uncountable
Some nouns can be both, with different meanings.
> I'm going to buy **a paper** (= a newspaper).
> I need **some paper** to write on.

## Words that are uncountable in English
**information, advice, news, weather, bread, hair, furniture, work** are uncountable. We don't use **a / an** or **-s** with them.
> I need **some information** about hotels. (not ~~an information~~)
> It's **nice weather** today. (not ~~a nice weather~~)
> I've just had **some good news**. (not ~~a good news~~)
> I'm going to buy **some bread**.
> Sue has got very long **hair**.
> They've got **some nice furniture**.
> It's **hard work**.

## How to count them
**a piece of** information / advice / news / furniture, **a loaf of** bread, **a slice of** bread.

## Verb
With uncountable nouns the verb is singular: *The news **is** good.*

## Common mistakes
- ~~I need an advice.~~ → I need **some advice**.
- ~~It's a nice weather.~~ → It's **nice weather**.
- ~~The news are bad.~~ → The news **is** bad.
structure:
## a, an, some
| Существительное | Что ставим | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| исчисляемое, ед. ч. | a / an | a car, an apple |
| исчисляемое, мн. ч. | some | some cars, some apples |
| неисчисляемое | some | some money, some cheese |

## Ловушки
| Нельзя | Можно |
|---|---|
| ~~an information~~ | some information / a piece of information |
| ~~informations~~ | some information |
| ~~an advice~~ | some advice / a piece of advice |
| ~~a good news~~ | some good news / a piece of news |
| ~~a bread~~ | some bread / a loaf of bread |
| ~~hairs~~ (волосы) | hair |
| ~~furnitures~~ | furniture |
| ~~a hard work~~ | hard work |
| ~~a nice weather~~ | nice weather |

## Слова с двумя значениями
> a paper (газета) / some paper (бумага)
> a hair (волосок) / hair (волосы)
